name: It works, or it does not
about: Report whether the readout appears on your machine
title: "[works here] "
labels: ""
body: |
  The shortest useful report is the output of the selftest. Please paste it
  whole. It writes nothing.

  ```bash
  npx opencode-vitals@latest selftest
  ```

  Then two lines:

  - operating system and version:
  - did the numbers appear in the composer's action row, yes or no:

  ## Please do not paste conversation text

  This plugin never stores prompts or responses, and a report should not
  either. Timings, counts and identifiers are enough to find the problem.
